name: Rural Futurism
summary: Rural Futurism is a design and an art aesthetic that combines countryside, pastoral landscapes with advanced, sci-fi or high-tech elements, where this optimistic side of rural futurism envisions a sustainable, influenced harmony between high-technology and nature.
description: Rural Futurism is a design and an art aesthetic that combines countryside, pastoral landscapes with advanced, sci-fi or high-tech elements, where this optimistic side of rural futurism envisions a sustainable, influenced harmony between high-technology and nature. Instead of focusing on neon-lit, dense hyper-cities, it explores how cutting-edge technology interacts with agriculture, slow-paced village life and open spaces, where the aesthetic branches into several distinct visual vibes, ranging from optimistic eco-utopias to low-frequency, eerie dystopias, which imagines decentralized eco-villages where modern tech enhances and protects the ecosystem rather than diminishing the resources.
culturalContext: Key values (per the Aesthetics Wiki): Naturalism, The Diffusion between Futurism and Orientalism
